Theme

Latin word

tandem

adverb

in the end, after all; at last, finally, at length

In this lexicon

  • after all

    the recommended word · classical · Lucr. 5.137: soleret tandem in eōdem homine manēre, in the end, after all (Lewis & Short s.v. tandem); Ter. And. 3.4.7: tandem cognōstī quī siem (Lewis & Short)

  • finally

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. Ep. 1.7.73: tandem dormītum dīmittitur; Catull. 62.2: exspectāta diū vix tandem lūmina tollit; Traupman 315

Examples

  • dīcenda tacenda locūtus tandem dormītum dīmittitur

    having said everything, fit to say or not, he is finally sent off to bedHor. Ep. 1.7.72–73

    In the entry for finally

  • tertiō dēmum diē ad verticem perventum

    it was only on the third day that they finally reached the topLiv. 40.22.4

    In the entry for finally

  • ut tandem aliquandō timēre dēsinam

    so that at long last I may stop being afraidCic. Cat. 1.18

    In the entry for finally

  • nunc tandem

    now at lastTraupman 88

    In the entry for finally
